interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The snowline
interactives.text: The snowline is read against stones the votaries set. What is made under the temple is measured before it is trusted, and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The shrine's under-room. Books read three times as fast in the cold quiet.

interactives.label: The snowline
interactives.text: The snowline moved uphill nineteen days in one year. The cascade froze on the twentieth.

interactives.label: Passes
interactives.text: Three passes leave the range, each cut level through the rim. The floor is walkable to the edge; the walls are not.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Nineteen days
interactives.text: The cascade watcher counted nineteen days of the snowline climbing. The aqueduct warden counted twenty.

interactives.label: The mine
interactives.text: The mine was sunk for silver and found ice. The ice was worth more.

interactives.label: The temple
interactives.text: The glacier temple's altar is a block of the glacier. It has not moved in a century; the glacier has.

interactives.label: The Mine Reliquary
interactives.text: The miners' relic room, opened with glacier salt.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Cold
interactives.text: Cold protection is a spell and a cape. The range takes a point of health an hour from anyone with neither.

sections.name: The Silverleaf Hollow
sections.label: A crack in the ice, wider than it looks, and warm air rising from it.
sections.note: A hollow behind the frozen cascade where the silverleaf grows out of the wind.

sections.name: The Cairn Garden
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: A walled garden under the lower cairns, warmer than the field it hides in.

sections.name: The South Gate Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The gate's cellar: chest, bench and the ore the gate-keepers trade on the side.

sections.name: The Glacier Temple Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The votaries' strongroom under the temple.

sections.name: The Ram Pit
sections.label: A crack in the ice, wider than it looks, and warm air rising from it.
sections.note: A crevasse floor where the rangers pen rams for the young to learn horn on.

sections.name: The Snowline School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the snowline rangers learn the stones.

sections.name: The Cascade Spring
sections.label: A crack in the ice, wider than it looks, and warm air rising from it.
sections.note: Behind the second cascade the rock is warm; the votaries call it the range's one kindness.

sections.name: The Rope Bridge Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the bridgehead with crabs at the far end.

sections.name: The Mine Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: The miners' relic room, opened with glacier salt.

sections.name: The Ice Well
sections.label: A crack in the ice, wider than it looks, and warm air rising from it.
sections.note: Blue ice swallows every spell; the wolves penned here hunt without one.

sections.name: The Cairn Ridge Focus
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: Under the ridge cairns the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Ice-Bore
sections.label: A crack in the ice, wider than it looks, and warm air rising from it.
sections.note: A bore the miners drove under the rim, out above Mirrorhold's north post.

sections.name: The Horn Waystone
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: Three stones under the west watch cairns. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Temple Eyrie
sections.label: A crack in the ice, wider than it looks, and warm air rising from it.
sections.note: A pocket in the temple's cliff over the glacier.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Whitehorn Range Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
